title: WNM-3D: A World Navigation Model with 3D Scene Conditioning for Closed-Loop VLN
abstract: arXiv:2608.07267v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent vision-language navigation (VLN) systems increasingly adapt pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) into vision-language-action (VLA) policies that map egocentric observations and language instructions directly to navigation actions. Although semantically capable, such action-centric training does not explicitly model how the agent's visual observations should evolve under its predicted motion. Generative world-action models (WAMs) jointly predict future observations and actions, yet existing WAMs for continuous VLN do not condition joint future-view and action generation on geometry-aware representations inferred from the observed history. We present WNM-3D, a generative World Navigation Model with 3D scene conditioning for continuous VLN. translated_title: WNM-3D：一种具有3D场景条件的世界导航模型，用于闭环视觉语言导航
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.07267v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：最近的视觉语言导航（VLN）系统越来越多地将预训练的视觉语言模型（VLMs）适应为视觉语言行动（VLA）策略，这些策略将自我中心的观察和语言指令直接映射到导航动作。尽管在语义上具有能力，但这种以行动为中心的训练并未明确建模代理的视觉观察应如何在其预测运动下演变。生成式世界行动模型（WAMs）联合预测未来观察和行动，然而，现有的用于连续VLN的WAMs并未将联合的未来视图和行动生成条件化为从观察历史中推断出的几何感知表示。我们提出了WNM-3D，一种具有3D场景条件的生成式世界导航模型，用于连续VLN。为了将过去的观察整合为持久的场景上下文，一个冻结的前馈几何编码器从单眼自我中心RGB历史中提取几何感知表示，该表示随后用于条件化未来视图和行动的生成。
tldr: WNM-3D通过冻结的几何编码器提取3D场景表示，并将其作为条件来联合生成未来观察和导航动作，从而改进了连续视觉语言导航中的世界行动模型。
en_tdlr: WNM-3D improves continuous vision-language navigation by conditioning joint future-view and action generation on geometry-aware 3D scene representations extracted via a frozen encoder.
